productivity_and_cost.timing_limit: One uncontrolled local run. Part of benchmark overlapped a separate regression run/system activity; no isolated performance advantage, CPU cost, SLA or human time saving is inferred.

human_review_burden: NOT MEASURED. No human-confirmed real gold, semantic citation scores, task grades, correction minutes or review minutes were collected.
iteration_evidence: Independent review exposed three scorer defects before the recorded benchmark: >5 source IDs from one page, permissive Evidence substring and implicit gold misses. Fixed source projection, exact pointer plus recorded-byte checks and explicit HIT/MISS outcomes; regression tests cover the reproduced defects.
80 pairs versus 160 arm executions are reported separately. Twenty-three protocol-only rubrics are explicitly NOT RUN.
An optional final review-agent follow-up hit a usage limit; it is not counted as completed review. The root checked the fixes and all 12 targeted metric tests plus the entire 234-test suite passed.
remaining_limitations: A deterministic raw adapter is not a competent AI baseline; B curated aliases and layout can improve fixture recall without improving real reasoning or productivity.

B still misses 18/72 nonempty-gold cases; A misses 32/72. Lexical full-phrase matching misses unlisted paraphrases and grouped keyword strings such as request timeout timeout_ms when queried by a shorter phrase.
Structural citations and source-ID gold agreement do not prove claim meaning or factual truth; synthetic gold itself lacks independent human confirmation.
All main-corpus pages remain unverified, so this does not measure practical use of human-approved current decisions. Existing governance behavior remains covered by prior regressions.
Twenty-three case-specific protocol rubrics, actual coding/research output, paired AI fresh sessions and real compounding value remain NOT RUN/NOT MEASURED.
Human identity, host containment, physical power loss, dense dependency graphs and earlier Medium/Low audit findings are unchanged residual risks.
V1_recommendations: Review exact keyword phrases and API/identifier entries separately instead of joining unrelated terms into one phrase. Keep unlisted paraphrases as holdout gold; do not rewrite expected results to make the benchmark pass.
Preserve HIT/MISS, citation meaning and current-authority outcomes as separate metrics; prioritize human source review over increasing file count.

If a pilot is separately authorized, curate a small nonsensitive corpus, human-confirm gold and permissions, freeze model/tools and run balanced independent A/B sessions with the same raw/decision access.
Collect complete intake/synthesis/review/correction/Lint/conflict overhead alongside task outcomes before estimating reusable value or considering infrastructure upgrades.
V2_recommendation: Do not start V2. No practical-value or net-cost evidence currently justifies it; do not introduce QMD, embeddings, database or framework on these proxy scores.
approval_items: No new permission is required to finish this authorized synthetic harness. Real sources, human-confirmed gold, source rights and real pilot task/tool scope need a separate direct user task. No real knowledge or decision approval was created.
